images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of theContinualSkillBenchpipeline. Phase 1 collects approximately 30,000 tasks from five domains. Phase 2 uses LLM-assisted filtering, skill-dependency analysis, task ordering, and human review to construct five sequential task streams. Phase 3 evaluates agents through instruction, execution, and reflection, comparing Sequential and Independent execution with their performance difference reported asΔ\Delta.

Figure 2:Taxonomy ofContinualSkillBench. The inner ring shows the five domains, the middle summarizes three macro capability tracks within each domain, and the outer lists the source datasets and benchmarks.

Figure 3:Skill-library behavior of GPT-4o and GPT-5.3-Codex across five domains. The left panel shows how frequently generated skills are invoked in later tasks, and the right panel shows the final skill repository size. These statistics describe skill maintenance but do not directly establish skill utility.
